en: A black-and-white historical postcard showing a wide cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑story townhouses with shops on the ground floors. In the foreground stands a small pavilion or kiosk with people gathered around, and a few pedestrians walking across the open square. In the background, behind the row of buildings, a church spire is visible. Printed text at the top identifies the place.
